name: Code By AI
description: Unified API gateway for AI coding agents: one API key and one prepaid balance for Claude, GPT/Codex and Gemini models, usable from Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and other coding tools via an OpenAI-compatible base URL (https://www.codebyai.net/api/agent/v1). Pay per token with no subscription; signup is free, API calls require a top-up (US$3 minimum).
